articles.title: 背内侧导水管周围灰质谷氨酸能神经元在多种全身麻醉药促进觉醒中的作用

sections.heading: BACKGROUND
sections.text: 全身麻醉可能涉及共享的神经机制。中脑导水管周围灰质（PAG）在生理性、本能性行为以及睡眠-觉醒调节中发挥关键作用。然而，背内侧中脑导水管周围灰质（dmPAG）在调节麻醉-觉醒状态中的作用仍不清楚。本研究旨在探讨dmPAG谷氨酸能神经元在多种全身麻醉药促进觉醒中的作用。

sections.heading: METHODS
sections.text: 对雌雄小鼠给予多种全身麻醉药，包括七氟烷、丙泊酚、氯胺酮和右美托咪定。采用钙成像技术监测麻醉和觉醒期间dmPAG内谷氨酸能神经元的活性变化。使用光遗传学和化学遗传学方法操纵神经元活性，并评估其对麻醉诱导、维持和恢复的影响。此外，分析脑电图记录以评估麻醉下频谱功率和爆发抑制比的变化。

sections.heading: RESULTS
sections.text: 在七氟烷麻醉期间，dmPAG谷氨酸能神经元活性受到抑制，而在觉醒期间增加，所有测试的静脉麻醉药均观察到类似模式。光遗传学激活dmPAG谷氨酸能神经元显著延长了七氟烷麻醉的诱导时间（绿色荧光蛋白[GFP] vs. ChR2，218.8 ± 50.83 s vs. 372.5 ± 40.18 s，P < 0.001）并缩短了苏醒时间（GFP vs. ChR2，230.8 ± 40.44 s vs. 135 ± 19.82 s，P < 0.001）。在维持麻醉期间观察到觉醒特征的脑电图变化，爆发抑制比降低（GFP vs. ChR2：50.08 ± 8.21% vs. 2.15 ± 3.38%，P < 0.001）。化学遗传学激活产生类似效果，而化学遗传学抑制则增强了所有测试麻醉药的麻醉效果。

sections.heading: CONCLUSIONS
sections.text: 研究结果表明，dmPAG中的谷氨酸能神经元可能作为多种麻醉药的共同神经底物，在意识丧失和恢复中发挥关键作用。

articles.title: 麻醉培训中的气道超声：一项范围综述
articles.originalTitle: Airway ultrasound in anaesthesia training: a scoping review.

sections.heading: BACKGROUND
sections.text: 气道超声在麻醉中用于气道评估、气管插管确认和识别解剖变异方面已变得越来越有价值。尽管其临床作用日益增强，但在全球范围内，将其纳入麻醉培训项目的情况仍不一致。本范围综述旨在描绘气道超声培训的当前格局，并找出差距以指导未来发展。

sections.heading: METHODS
sections.text: 我们于2025年8月1日通过Ovid检索了MEDLINE和Embase，查找2000年后的同行评审出版物，以及来自专业学会网站和国家或机构课程中的灰色文献。纳入报告气道超声培训项目、教学方法或能力框架的文献。我们提取了关于课程内容、教学与评估以及实施因素的数据，并进行描述性分析。

sections.heading: RESULTS
sections.text: 检索策略共获得215篇同行评审文献和17篇灰色文献。排除后，确定11条记录，包括8项同行评审研究和3篇灰色文献。其中，10项描述了气道超声纳入培训的情况。所有项目均包含理论教学和实践元素，使用模拟、活体模型扫描或临床实践。课程内容强调上气道评估、气管插管和颈前通路。能力评估包括笔试和实践考试，四个国家项目还要求作品集。

sections.heading: CONCLUSIONS
sections.text: 尽管气道超声的临床价值日益得到认可，但其培训在课程内容和实施方式上存在显著的国际差异。正式教学仍不一致，且往往是可选的，受到师资专长、设备可用性和课程要求的限制。建立标准化的能力和基于证据的评估框架对于将气道超声有效融入麻醉实践至关重要。

abstractTranslation.fullText: BACKGROUND: Airway ultrasound has become increasingly valuable in anaesthesia for airway assessment, tracheal intubation confirmation, and identification of anatomical variation. Despite its growing clinical role, integration into anaesthesia training programmes remains inconsistent globally. This scoping review aimed to map the current landscape of airway ultrasound training and identify gaps to guide future development. METHODS: We searched MEDLINE and Embase via Ovid on August 1, 2025 for peer-reviewed publications after 2000, in addition to grey literature from professional society websites and national or institutional curricula. Literature reporting airway ultrasound training programmes, educational approaches, or competency frameworks was included. We extracted data on curriculum content, teaching and assessment, and implementation factors, analysing these descriptively. RESULTS: The search strategy yielded 215 peer-reviewed and 17 grey literature documents. articles.title: 麻醉期间做梦：一项范围综述
articles.originalTitle: Dreaming during anaesthesia: a scoping review.

sections.heading: BACKGROUND
sections.text: 麻醉期间的梦境已被记录了一个多世纪，但对其了解仍然有限。本范围综述综合了关于麻醉梦境的发生频率、现象学、预测因素、结局和神经关联的证据。

sections.heading: METHODS
sections.text: 我们系统检索了多个数据库，查找关于麻醉梦境的研究，包括临床试验、观察性研究以及在成人和儿童患者以及健康志愿者中进行的实验性研究。

sections.heading: RESULTS
sections.text: 我们确定了157项研究（1921-2024年），涉及87,866名参与者。梦境回忆率差异很大，实验环境中的回忆率较高（通常为40%-80%），而大规模临床试验中的回忆率较低（通常为3%-8%），这可能反映了方法学上的差异。氯胺酮（临床：0%-95%；实验：44%-100%）和丙泊酚（临床：0%-64%；实验：0%-77%）与回忆的关联最为一致。梦境主要为愉快的，包含日常自传体内容。较高的家庭梦境回忆频率、术前暗示或启动，以及苏醒后立即评估与较高的回忆率相关。关于临床结局的证据有限，但不愉快的梦境与再次接受相同麻醉的意愿降低相关。梦境回忆与术中知晓无关，这对将梦境视为麻醉深度不足标志的解释提出了挑战。新兴的神经证据表明，梦境表现出与无意识和连接意识不同的特征。

sections.heading: CONCLUSIONS
sections.text: 麻醉梦境是常见的，主要为积极的，并且具有药理学特异性。知识上的主要空白包括定义不一致、评估方法不足、机制理解有限、儿科研究稀少以及结局数据极少。需要以意识科学和睡眠研究为依据的标准化方法。麻醉梦境的积极性和可暗示性提示了值得研究的潜在治疗应用。

abstractTranslation.fullText: BACKGROUND: Dreaming during anaesthesia has been documented for over a century, yet it remains poorly understood. This scoping review synthesises evidence on the frequency, phenomenology, predictors, outcomes, and neural correlates of anaesthesia dreaming. METHODS: We systematically searched multiple databases for studies examining anaesthesia dreaming, including clinical trials, observational studies, and experimental investigations in adult and paediatric patients, as well as in healthy volunteers. RESULTS: We identified 157 studies (1921-2024) involving 87 866 participants. Dream recall varied widely, with higher rates in experimental settings (often 40%-80%) compared with large-scale clinical trials (typically 3%-8%), likely reflecting methodological differences. Ketamine (clinical: 0%-95%; experimental: 44%-100%) and propofol (clinical: 0%-64%; experimental: 0%-77%) were most consistently associated with recall. Dreams were predominantly pleasant, featuring everyday autobiographical content. Higher home dream recall frequency, preoperative suggestion or priming, and immediate post-emergence assessment were associated with higher recall. Evidence regarding clinical outcomes was limited, but unpleasant dreams were linked to lower willingness to undergo the same anaesthetic again. Dream recall was not associated with intraoperative awareness, challenging interpretations of dreams as markers of inadequate anaesthetic depth. Emerging neural evidence suggests that dreaming exhibits signatures distinct from unconsciousness and connected consciousness. CONCLUSIONS: Anaesthesia dreaming is common, predominantly positive, and pharmacologically specific. Major gaps in knowledge include inconsistent definitions, inadequate assessment methods, limited mechanistic understanding, sparse paediatric research, and minimal outcome data. Standardised approaches informed by consciousness science and sleep research are needed. The positive nature and suggestibility of anaesthesia dreams suggest potential therapeutic applications warranting investigation.

articles.title: 功能失调的静息态网络连接可预测大手术后谵妄
articles.originalTitle: Dysfunctional resting state network connectivity predicts postoperative delirium after major surgery.

sections.heading: BACKGROUND
sections.text: 术后谵妄与发病率、死亡率、未来认知衰退或痴呆的增加相关。理解区分个体大脑脆弱性的神经机制对于未来治疗发展和预防术后谵妄至关重要。我们研究了静息态功能连接受损预示谵妄易感性的假设。

sections.heading: METHODS
sections.text: 术前收集了120名接受大型择期非颅内手术的参与者（>65岁，52名女性）的血氧水平依赖功能磁共振成像数据。使用去噪后的血氧水平依赖信号时间序列（覆盖400个皮层区域）计算典型静息态网络内部及之间的静息态功能连接。我们使用支持向量机来确定跨高阶皮层网络的静息态功能连接是否可预测术后谵妄。

sections.heading: RESULTS
sections.text: 组间比较显示，与非谵妄参与者（n=89）相比，术后谵妄参与者（n=31）在突显-腹侧注意、认知控制和默认模式网络内的连接显著降低（非参数置换检验，1000次迭代，P<0.05）。我们发现默认模式网络内的整体连接较弱，且默认模式子网络之间存在特定差异，这些子网络与高阶认知处理重叠。监督机器学习识别出视觉和突显-腹侧注意网络预测术后谵妄发生率的准确率为68%。

sections.heading: CONCLUSIONS
sections.text: 静息态功能连接是术后谵妄易感性的神经相关性。高阶认知关联区域（包括默认模式网络、突显注意和认知控制网络）内的静息态连接中断与谵妄特异性相关。

articles.title: 心脏手术期间脑灌注压的血流动力学决定因素与术后谵妄的关联：一项回顾性队列研究
articles.originalTitle: Association of postoperative delirium with haemodynamic determinants of cerebral perfusion pressure during cardiac surgery: a retrospective cohort study.

sections.heading: BACKGROUND
sections.text: 心脏手术后谵妄很常见，一个重要因素可能是脑灌注。由于脑灌注压（CPP）由平均动脉压（MAP）和中心静脉压（CVP）之差决定，而这两者是可调节因素，因此了解它们与谵妄的关系至关重要。

sections.heading: METHODS
sections.text: 在一项回顾性队列研究中，使用ICU混淆评估法对接受心脏手术的患者进行谵妄评估。血流动力学暴露计算为在狭窄范围内的时间：14个MAP范围，以5 mm Hg递增（45-115）；10个CVP范围，以2 mm Hg递增（0-20）；以及70个MAP/CVP联合范围。分别建立回归模型，估计每个范围（或预定义的相邻范围区域）的比值比，并对协变量和多重比较进行校正。模拟估计了重新分配MAP/CVP暴露的影响。

sections.heading: RESULTS
sections.text: 在1759名患者中，345名（19.6%）发生谵妄。在将MAP和CVP范围分组的预定义区域中，谵妄与脑低灌注区域的时间相关（校正比值比1.02，95%置信区间1.00-1.03，P=0.04）。模拟减少脑低灌注和高灌注区域的时间可降低谵妄发生率，尤其是在这些区域暴露时间较长的患者中。谵妄还与高CVP/低MAP（低灌注）和高MAP/低CVP（高灌注）的单个血流动力学范围的时间相关。

sections.heading: CONCLUSIONS
sections.text: 在调整模型中，谵妄与低脑灌注压区域以及低和高脑灌注压的单个范围相关。评估优化脑灌注是否能减少谵妄的试验是必要的，但可能需要大量入组或预后富集。

abstractTranslation.fullText: BACKGROUND: Delirium is common after cardiac surgery, and an important factor could be cerebral perfusion. As cerebral perfusion pressure (CPP) is determined by the difference between mean arterial pressure (MAP) and central venous pressure (CVP), which are modifiable factors, understanding their relationship with delirium is essential. METHODS: In a retrospective cohort study, patients undergoing cardiac surgery were assessed for delirium using the Confusion Assessment Method for the ICU. Haemodynamic exposures were calculated as time spent in narrow ranges: 14 MAP ranges in increments of 5 mm Hg (45-115), 10 CVP ranges in increments of 2 mm Hg (0-20), and 70 joint MAP/CVP ranges. Separate regression models estimated odds ratios for each range (or predefined zones of adjacent ranges), adjusted for covariates and multiple comparisons. Simulations estimated the effect of redistributing MAP/CVP exposures. RESULTS: In 1759 patients, 345 (19.6%) developed delirium. In predefined zones that grouped MAP and CVP ranges, delirium was associated with time spent in the cerebral hypoperfusion zone (adjusted odds ratio 1.02, 95% confidence interval 1.00-1.03, P=0.04). Simulated reductions of time in zones of cerebral hypoperfusion and hyperperfusion reduced delirium, particularly in patients with prolonged exposures to these zones. There were also associations between delirium and time in individual haemodynamic ranges of high CVP/low MAP (hypoperfusion) and high MAP/low CVP (hyperperfusion). CONCLUSIONS: Delirium was associated with a zone of low cerebral perfusion pressure in adjusted models and individual ranges of low and high cerebral perfusion pressures. Trials to assess whether optimising cerebral perfusion reduces delirium are needed but may require large enrolment or prognostic enrichment.
